interpretations: Main reading: add a new optional plain-text 'storage conditions' column to the product model with a migration, expose it through the API (staff can write it, the public can read it), add an input to the dashboard product form, and show it as its own labeled block near or below the product description on the storefront product page.

Reuse what already exists instead of changing the schema: define 'Storage conditions' as a product attribute or metadata key. Staff edit it through the existing attribute or metadata UI in the dashboard, and the storefront reads and shows that attribute.

Literal 'in the product description' reading: the text goes into the description content itself. It is either added to the rich-text description when the product is saved, or inserted into the rendered description, so there is no separate block on the storefront.

Structured field instead of free text: for example a min/max temperature with a unit, or a fixed list of options (ambient, refrigerated, frozen) plus optional notes. The storefront builds the sentence from these values.
Localized field: the storage conditions text is translatable per language through the existing translation mechanism, rather than a single untranslated string.
open_questions: Should this be a new dedicated field on the product model, or should it use the existing attribute or metadata system?

On the storefront, should the text be merged into the description content, or shown as a separate labeled section next to the description? What label and position should it have, and what should appear when it is empty?
Is it free text or structured (temperature range and unit, preset options)? Is it plain text or rich text, and what is the maximum length?
Is it optional for every product, or required for certain product types or categories (for example perishable goods)?
Does it need translations for multi-language storefronts?
Is the storefront part of this codebase, and is exposing the field through the public API part of the work? Which staff permissions are needed to edit it?
Does it belong at product level only, or can variants have different storage conditions?
Which tests are expected (model/API, dashboard UI, storefront rendering or e2e)? Does 'passes locally' include lint, type checks and the full existing suite?
Should it also show up elsewhere: cart, checkout, order emails, product import/export, bulk edit, or structured SEO data?
Should existing products be backfilled with values, or left empty?
reason: The ticket says clearly what to build (a storage conditions value that staff edit in the dashboard and customers see on the storefront) and who uses it, and it has a basic definition of done. It leaves open how to store the value (new field or attribute, free text or structured, translated or not), where exactly to show it ('in the product description' could mean inside the text or next to it), and what kind of tests are expected. Nothing in it conflicts outright, but these gaps could lead to quite different implementations.
